n: OpenLearn Machine translation in language learning
t: Free Open University guidance on using machine translation in language classes.
steps: Find the OpenLearn article on machine translation in language learning.
Read it and pick one activity.
Check district approval for DeepL or Google Translate before students use them.
Prepare a short text in the target language.
Create a free OpenLearn account only if you want the companion course.
Plan a short talk about academic integrity.
